en: The image displays a colorized historical building, resembling a large, rectangular military barracks complex with four stories, high windows, and fortified roof edges. The street in front is broad and largely empty except for a few people walking and some sparse landscaping and fencing in the foreground. The text at the top of the image reads: 'Kaserne d. K. S. 3 Feld-Art.-Regt. No. 32.' and 'Riesa a. Elbe.'
